message.content: The saved selection is Valarie Bachelor for District 6 Governing Board Member / School Director. On November 9, 2023, Bachelor introduced an OUSD resolution calling for a ceasefire in Gaza, hostage release, Israeli troop withdrawal, mourning lives in Israel and Palestine, and combating antisemitism and Islamophobia. The next day she described the board's aim as seeking peace over continued bloodshed, invoking the "eye for an eye" proverb to argue against escalation. CAIR Action and AROC Action each endorsed Bachelor in the general phase. The other candidate with recorded observations, LeAna Powell, stated she would urge the superintendent to implement AB 715 and would avoid international-policy positions without broad community agreement, focusing instead on school responsibilities. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated purpose includes supporting Israel as a democratic and secure Jewish state, endorsed Powell in the general phase.
